summary: Curates the Celestial Chase Revive BlastEm scene-transition probe as bounded operational guidance: SRAM READY/SCN/INP can prove a declared transition when tied to a fresh ROM hash, while ROM-observed input outranks host-side dispatch claims.

accepted_lessons.summary: READY + SCN + INP SRAM proof can validate a named scene transition only when tied to the same ROM hash and a fresh capture.
Input dispatch by the host is not enough for navigation claims; ROM-observed input is required when the project exposes that probe.
A TITLE -> OPENING_CUTSCENE probe does not promote first playable, gameplay, visual delivery, audio, VDP budget or ready_for_aaa.

rejected_or_limited_claims: Do not promote wm_key_message_to_sdl_window as a universal canonical transport from one host/session.
Do not treat TITLE -> OPENING_CUTSCENE as first playable or gameplay_rom_aprovada.
Do not treat absence of visual_vdp_dump.bin as acceptable for visual claims; it is acceptable only for minimal runtime seed/probe scope with no visual claim.
required_followups: Add wrapper-level canonical support and tests for alternative BlastEm input transport before changing automation defaults.
Repeat the SRAM scene/input probe pattern in another project or transition before creating a new schema or skill.
Use BlastEm, fresh SRAM and ROM hash for future scene-transition claims.
Require visual_vdp_dump.bin or equivalent VDP evidence when a transition proof is also used for visual or budget claims.
non_goals: No SGDK_projects file is modified by this curation.
No status is promoted to ready_for_aaa, testado_em_emulador, validado_budget or buildado.
